pairs: Now the Spirit has clearly said that,
quia in novissimis temporibus discedent quidam a fide,
some persons will depart from the faith,
paying attention to spirits of error and the doctrines of devils,
quod Deus creavit ad percipiendum cum gratiarum actione fidelibus,
which God has created to be accepted with thanksgiving by the faithful
and by those who have understood the truth.
Quia omnis creatura Dei bona est,
For every creature of God is good,
et nihil rejiciendum quod cum gratiarum actione percipitur:
and nothing is to be rejected which is received with thanksgiving;
for it has been sanctified by the Word of God
By proposing these things to the brothers,
bonus eris minister Christi Jesu enutritus verbis fidei,
you will be a good minister of Christ Jesus,
and by the good doctrine that you have secured.
Ineptas autem, et aniles fabulas devita:
But avoid the silly fables of old women.
And exercise yourself so as to advance in piety.
Nam corporalis exercitatio, ad modicum utilis est:
For the exercise of the body is somewhat useful.
pietas autem ad omnia utilis est,
But piety is useful in all things,
in the present and in the future.
because we hope in the living God,
who is the Savior of all men,
Let no one despise your youth,
sed exemplum esto fidelium in verbo,
but be an example among the faithful in word,
Noli negligere gratiam, quæ in te est,
Do not be willing to neglect the grace that is within you,
quæ data est tibi per prophetiam,
which was given to you through prophecy,
with the imposition of the hands of the priesthood.
ut profectus tuus manifestus sit omnibus.
so that your progress may be manifest to all.
and those who listen to you.
